title: ふじの山 (Fuji no Yama — Mount Fuji)
description: A bold, proud 1910 song celebrating Japan's most iconic mountain. Mount Fuji lifts its head above the clouds, looks down upon the surrounding peaks, and hears thunder rumbling below — truly the greatest mountain in Japan. Selected for Japan's 100 Best Songs by the Agency for Cultural Affairs and still taught in elementary schools today.
license: Public Domain (Lyrics by 巖谷小波; published 1910 in 尋常小学読本唱歌 — copyright expired)
